title: Replay-buffer engineering for noise-aware quantum circuit optimization
summary: Deep reinforcement learning for quantum circuit optimization faces three bottlenecks: replay buffers that overlook temporal difference (TD) target reliability, curriculum-based architecture search requiring a full quantum-classical evaluation after every edit, and the discard of noiseless trajectories when retraining under hardware noise. We address these limitations by treating replay as a central algorithmic lever.
